name: Munna Bhai Nahi
visual_description: Sanjay Dutt as Munna Bhai in a cyan shirt responding bluntly with a yellow subtitle reading 'Nahi'.
usage_context: Used to convey a flat, blunt, and unapologetic refusal or denial to an unreasonable question or request.

example.top_text: Boss: Can you complete this task over the weekend?

text_areas.description: The setup question or request prompting a blunt refusal
